business_problem: Handling over 10 million transactions a day, PayU GPO requires robust risk mitigation measures. Central to this is the Know-Your-Customer (KYC) process, which involves verifying the identity of customers through a series of checks to ensure they are who they claim to be.
solution_summary: In financial services where milliseconds matter, PayU Global Payment Organization (GPO) took a decisive step to accelerate its customer onboarding. PayU provides payment solutions for over 450,000 merchants and counting. Hence, the need for a swift and error-proof identity verification workflow is high. That’s where AU10TIX came into play. The firm boosted PayU's Know-Your-Customer (KYC) process with its Microsoft Azure-based Identity Verification (IDV) solution. ID verification has been reduced to an average of six seconds, making the entire process more efficient and customer-friendly. The partnership also brought scalability, enabling PayU GPO to smoothly manage influxes of new customers in the most intense periods with Azure's flexible infrastructure. PayU GPO enables businesses to accept and process payments with ease by offering hundreds of payment methods as well as PCI-certified platforms.
